messages:
mia: Pushed a new embeddings candidate (heron-emb-v2) to staging with int8 per-tensor quant. Ran our short-query holdout and seeing a consistent drop in recall@10 (~22% relative) compared to the fp16 baseline.
aj: ugh. paste the eval command and the top few rows of the results?
mia: eval command: ```bash
python eval_embeddings.py --model heron-emb-v2 --quant int8 --holdout short_queries.csv --metric recall@10 --normalize
```
mia: head of results csv: ```
query_id,recall@10
q0001,0.48
q0002,0.51
q0003,0.40
q0004,0.35
q0005,0.47
```
aj: baseline fp16 numbers for same holdout were ~0.62-0.65 range, right?
mia: yep, fp16 run earlier today: q0001..q0005 -> 0.63,0.66,0.61,0.58,0.64
ryan: did you try per-channel quant or symmetric vs asymmetric? per-channel often helps for small-dim embeddings.
mia: this build was per-tensor symmetric. I can re-run per-channel. also wondering if bias/folding during quantization got dropped.
diane: quick sanity: can you check L2 norm distribution delta between fp16 and int8 for the short queries? my hunch is magnitude shift causing nearest-neighbor mis-ranks.
mia: good call. raw norms: fp16_mean_norm=1.12, int8_mean_norm=0.74, std similar. that's suspicious.
ci-bot: CI:eval-run #3089 completed for heron-emb-v2: regression detected on suite 'short-query-fast' (delta recall@10 = -0.22). See pipeline run: https://ci.redwood/3089
aj: if norms are scaled down, try re-applying scale & bias correction at export or enable `--post-quant-scale-fix` in converter. Also test cosine vs dot product reranking.
mia: re-ran with per-channel + bias-corr flag. quick numbers: recall@10 recovered to ~0.60 on coarse check.
ryan: nice. can you also run clustering stability (UMAP + kmeans) for short vs long queries? we saw centroid shifts earlier with prior models.
diane: I plotted UMAP for short queries — centroids moved compared to fp16; short queries compress into tight blob after per-tensor quant. link: https://internal-grafana/plots/emb-1951 (will attach full svg in thread)
mia: next steps: 1) run full sweep (per-channel, bias-corr, symmetric/asymmetric) across short/long holdouts 2) add post-quant L2-rescale step 3) run knn recall@1/5/10 and clustering drift report. aiming to finish EOD.
aj: ping me if you want a second GPU. I can allocate a 3090 group.
ryan: please include a short PR description when you push converter changes (what flags, why). keep eval artifacts in /evals/heron-v2/shortquery/
mia: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
